images.title: The market lane: one stop for each idea
images.purpose: Give the chapter's ideas in one picture, in order along the lane, as a map for the revision.
images.composition: A title, one lane with six stops each with a small picture and a name, and a short fact under four of the stops.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TITLE at the top left, x 60, y 70: the text The market lane (48 px, bold, dark #1F2937). LANE: a thick grey #6B7280 horizontal line 10 px at y 400 from x 40 to x 1416 with a small arrowhead at the right end. SIX STOPS, each a rounded rectangle 190 by 190 px with a 4 px outline #1F2937, filled in turn pale teal #CCE5F2 and pale amber #FBE7C0, with their left edges at x 60, 282, 504, 726, 948, 1170 and y 305 to 495, so that the lane passes behind the middle of each: stop 1 holds a small round scale with a needle; stop 2 holds two short number lines one above the other; stop 3 holds a two column sum with a carry circle; stop 4 holds a price tag; stop 5 holds a small jug; stop 6 holds a question mark. STOP NAMES under the stops, centred on each stop at y 540 (30 px, bold, dark #1F2937): Units and scales; kg and g; Add and subtract; Cost and scaling; Litres and ml; Problems. STOP FACTS at y 620 to 720, centred on each stop (26 px, dark): 1 kg = 1,000 g under stop 2; 1,000 g exchanged for 1 kg under stop 3; both lines times the same number under stop 4; 1 l = 1,000 ml under stop 5. Stops 1 and 6 have no fact line. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The chapter's ideas follow one another along one lane: units and scales, kg and g, adding and subtracting, cost and scaling, litres and ml, problems.
images.description: A lane with six stops: units and scales, kg and g, add and subtract, cost and scaling, litres and ml, problems.
images.context: Concept image for Chapter Revision: Weight and Capacity. It is a map of the chapter's ideas and carries only facts the chapter teaches.
images.teaching_notes: Use it to walk through the ideas in order. The slip to watch: treating the stops as separate topics with nothing in common.

image_decisions.why: One lane with six stops gives the chapter's whole path in one look.
